get.description:
读取当前登录用户资料。

022 FR-15（T032 / QF-637）：GET 必须无副作用。原先这里会顺手刷新
``session.available_tenants``（惰性初始化），属于缓存写语义但字面上违反
『GET 不修改任何状态』—— 重复 GET 会推进 ``updated_at``，代理/CDN 缓存
与浏览器重放都可能产生非预期的数据变更。写入动作拆到
:func:`refresh_tenant_snapshot`（``POST /auth/me/refresh-tenants``）。

post.description:
显式刷新当前会话的租户快照（022 FR-15 / T032）。

从 ``GET /auth/me`` 拆出的写操作：重新计算 ``available_tenants`` 并写回
会话文档。用 POST 显式声明"这次调用有副作用"，前端在需要刷新租户列表时
主动调用，而不是每次读资料都附带写。

门户 SSO 第一步：以服务身份为某 MOGO 终端用户签发一次性登录票据。

门户（持牌外部服务）调用本端点，chat-api 校验服务身份后，按共享主键
``end_users._id`` 解析用户并签发一次性票据（TTL 60s，``PORTAL_SSO_SECRET`` 签名）。
票据**绝不下落 URL**，由门户经前端 ``window.history.state`` 带进 user-web。
匹配失败即拒绝（无 JIT）；单租户票据携带 ``tenant_id``，多租户只携带身份。

门户 SSO 第二步：前端携一次性票据 POST 换票建会话。

验签（fail-closed）→ 按 ``session_id`` accept-once（第二次 401）→ 解析用户 →
单租户直建会话（复用 :func:`_create_session`）/ 多租户返回选租户挑战 / 跨租户拒绝。
单租户返回 ``{token, profile, expiresAt}`` 与登录接口同构，前端
:func:`handleLoginSuccess` 无需改动即可消费。

单点登录（SSO）：为已登录的用户加密生成用于管理后台的 access token，
并在 admin_sessions 中插入以允许后台免密登录。

get.description:
Serve a Tabler icon SVG by name, pre-processed for Fabric.js compatibility.

Tabler icons put fill/stroke on the <svg> root, but Fabric.js SVG parser
doesn't inherit parent attributes onto child elements. This endpoint injects
fill/stroke directly onto each <path>, <circle>, <line>, <polyline>, <rect>
so Fabric renders them correctly as stroked vector shapes.

post.description:
显式标记会话的计划任务消息为已读（022 FR-15 / T032）。

从 ``GET /sessions/{id}`` 拆出的写操作：把 ``scheduled_unread`` 置为 False。

End a 002 session → emits the 009 ``SessionEnd`` event (FR-1 / FR-12).

This is the normal end-of-session seam. It is what drives the 017 tiered
memory sedimentation; ``delete_session`` is for removal, not for ending.

Idempotent — ending an already-ended session is a no-op that returns the
current state without re-triggering sedimentation.

Persist a recorded browser trajectory as a composite_task skill.

The agent's recorder emits semantic events while the user walks
through the real flow; this endpoint converts them into the same
CompositeStep YAML shape the manual editor produces, so downstream
consumers (parser, runtime, UI) stay on a single code path.

Run the FR-8 constraint checks over the tenant's KG (015 残项修复).

The request body carries the constraint bundle as plain data:

(relation + max_per_node) and ``transitive_relations``. Conflicts are
returned, affected nodes are marked conflicted (FR-14), and the audit
event flows to the 001 governance stream (kg.audited).

get.description:
Health check endpoint to verify backend status.

In multi-replica deployments the payload lists per-replica DSH Runtime Host
health (``dsh_hosts``), so an operator can see exactly which replica is down
rather than a single aggregate boolean.

Readiness requires at least one DSH Runtime Host replica to be reachable.

With multiple replicas this no longer fails when ``base_urls[0]`` alone is
down but the load balancer can still route around it to a healthy replica.
